newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak SAX index falls on broader issues losses.
newsitem.headline: Slovak SAX index falls on broader issues losses.

text.p: Slovak blue chips, hit hard in recent days, stabilised on the Bratislava Stock Exchange on Tuesday, but losses to several broader pharmaceutical issues pulled the 16-share SAX index down 4.8 points to 197.08.
Slovakofarma fell 670 crowns to 4,200 and Biotika lost 145 crowns to close at 755, while major issues Slovnaft and VSZ steel were unchanged.
"Foreign investors, who helped to keep the prices at these issues over last few weeks, have fulfilled their buy orders and have abandoned the market for a while," said Libor Briska of Creditanstalt.
He added current general downturn in the market, however, should not hurt larger issues such as Slovnaft and VSZ in the near future.
"We will maybe see a correction of a few crowns, in these (issues), but I don't expect any serious decline there," he said.
Overall volume decreased to 195,174 shares, from 322,626 shares traded on Monday, while turnover fell to 77.35 million crowns, from 102.96 million.
